about: Advisories reviewed and accepted, with why. The deploy audit (update.sh) leaves these out of the admins' alert. Review them when the dependency that pulls them in releases a fix.

accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0330: libcrux-kem 0.0.9 (through openmls_rust_crypto 0.6): hybrid KEM seeds. Slop's chat uses only MLS_128_DHKEMX25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519, never the hybrid KEM. Pinned until openmls_rust_crypto updates. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0331: libcrux-kem 0.0.9: decoding short hybrid keys. As RUSTSEC-2026-0330. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0367: zip 4.6.1, only through tauri-plugin-updater 2, which unpacks an update only after verifying its signature. Slop's own installs use zip 9 with their own path checks. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2023-0071: rsa 0.9 (through jsonwebtoken): the Marvin attack needs private-key operations; Slop only verifies RS256 signatures with public keys (GitHub's OIDC tokens). No fixed release exists. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2024-0429: glib 0.18 (Tauri's GTK stack on Linux): unsound VariantStrIter, which Slop never uses. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2024-0370: proc-macro-error 1 is unmaintained: a build-time macro in Tauri's GTK stack. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0173: proc-macro-error2 is unmaintained: build-time only. Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0370: zvariant is unmaintained (Tauri's D-Bus stack on Linux). Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0371: zbus_names is unmaintained (Tauri's D-Bus stack on Linux). Reviewed 2026-10-20.
accepted.RUSTSEC-2026-0372: zvariant_derive is unmaintained (Tauri's D-Bus stack on Linux). Reviewed 2026-10-20.
